```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
p5_facet <- plotReducedDim(spe_combined,
                            dimred = "UMAP_harmony",
                            colour_by = "disease_state",
                            point_size = 0.3,
                            point_alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ spe_combined$disease_state) +
  labs(title = "UMAP After Harmony Batch Correction",
       subtitle = "Faceted by disease state") +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1)))

p5_facet
```

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Filter to patients of interest
patients_of_interest <- c("Patient12", "Patient17", "Patient20_425", "Patient20_519")

spe_sub <- spe_combined[, spe_combined$patient_id %in% patients_of_interest]

# Facet by sample_id (ROI) within each patient
plotReducedDim(spe_sub,
               dimred = "UMAP_harmony",
               colour_by = "sample_id",
               point_size = 0.3,
               point_alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ spe_sub$patient_id, ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "UMAP After Harmony - Patients with Isolated Clusters",
       subtitle = "Colored by ROI, faceted by patient") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


